In loving memory of Justin Tak Chan                     \r\nAn integral part of the FIFA Gameplay Team, Justin joined us in time for FIFA07 and helped transform the series into what you see today. Over the years, Justin worked on some of the biggest features for the FIFA franchise including but not limited to our Trapping system, our Tackling system, and Two Player headers.  He also played a big part in incorporating our ANT(Animation Engine) technology into the game and advancing that technology over the years.  This year for FIFA12 he was responsible for Pushing and Pulling, Shielding, Jostling and played a major part in the Player Impact Engine integration. Our team and the FIFA franchise wouldn't have been the same without him.  Justin, you will be missed.
